column1: # merge-effect-class ci-only list (ADR-300). Columns: workflow file name, TAB, reason.
# MEANING. A row says the workflow is "not directly gated by the merged file list as a production act":
# it can run when a pull request merges to main (an unfiltered push, a workflow_run arm, a release, or a
# pull_request closed arm), but it does not, on its own, change production as a function of WHICH files
# the merge touched. It does NOT say the workflow is harmless. A valid reason can read "fires on release
# publication, downstream of the path-gated release workflow, covered by that row".
# USE. This file is test data plus the --pr applicability sentinel (it must be tracked at HEAD). The
# classifier never consults it for a verdict. plugins/soleur/test/merge-effect-class-parity.test.sh reads it:
# an enumerated workflow that is NOT listed here is treated as production, and the test then demands that
# its path filter cannot fire from an allowlisted path. Every row needs a non-empty reason; a row naming
# a workflow that is deleted, or no longer enumerated, fails the test. The list is review-owned: a
# mislabel only matters if the workflow fires on an allowlisted path, which the parity test's witness and
